plugins.name: velixar
plugins.description: Persistent cognitive memory for Claude Code. Remember decisions, recall context across sessions, detect contradictions, and build a knowledge graph — powered by Velixar.

skills.name: velixar-contradict
skills.description: Detect contradictions between current information and stored memories. Use when the user states a fact that might conflict with previously stored knowledge, when reviewing decisions that may have changed, or when the user says something that contradicts earlier context.
skills.description_zh: 检查当前信息与存储记忆的矛盾，适用于可能冲突的事实陈述、已变化决策及与此前上下文不一致的信息。

skills.name: velixar-recall
skills.description: Search persistent memory for relevant context. Use this to find past decisions, conventions, architecture notes, or anything previously stored.
skills.description_zh: 检索持久记忆中的相关上下文，查找过去决策、约定、架构笔记及已存内容。

skills.name: velixar-reflect
skills.description: Generate a cognitive briefing for the current session. Shows your identity profile, recent themes, and any contradictions. Run at the start of a session to orient yourself.
skills.description_zh: 为当前会话生成背景简报，展示身份档案、近期主题及矛盾，供会话开始时定位上下文。

skills.name: velixar-remember
skills.description: Store important context in persistent memory. Use when the user makes a decision, states a preference, describes architecture, encounters a bug fix, or establishes a convention that should be remembered across sessions. Also use when the user says "remember this", "save this", "note this down", or "don't forget".
skills.description_zh: 把决策、偏好、架构、修复及约定等重要上下文保存到Velixar持久记忆，供跨会话使用，也适用于明确要求记住或记录。

skills.name: velixar-session
skills.description: Consolidate the current session into persistent memory. Summarizes what was accomplished, decisions made, and open questions. Run this before ending a long coding session.
skills.description_zh: 将当前会话成果、决策及未决问题汇总为持久记忆，适用于结束较长编码会话前。

skills.name: velixar-setup
skills.description: Set up Velixar persistent memory for this Claude Code session. Run this to verify your API key is working and see what cognitive tools are available.
skills.description_zh: 为Claude Code会话设置Velixar持久记忆，验证API密钥并查看可用认知工具。
